}

4 Differential Expression & Biomarker Performance

grp_lvls <- levels(droplevels(as.factor(base_df[[group_col]])))
g1_lbl <- grp_lvls[1]
g2_lbl <- grp_lvls[2]
sp_keys <- if ("Panel" %in% names(base_df)) {
  paste(base_df[[assay_col]], base_df$Panel, sep = "___")
} else {
  as.character(base_df[[assay_col]])
}
de_rows <- lapply(split(seq_len(nrow(base_df)), sp_keys), function(idx) {
  sub <- base_df[idx, , drop = FALSE]
  vals <- sub[[value_col]]
  grps <- as.character(sub[[group_col]])
  v1 <- vals[grps == g1_lbl & !is.na(vals)]
  v2 <- vals[grps == g2_lbl & !is.na(vals)]
  tt <- if (length(v1) >= 2L && length(v2) >= 2L) {
    tryCatch(stats::t.test(v2, v1), error = function(e) NULL)
  } else NULL
  row <- data.frame(
    Assay     = as.character(sub[[assay_col]][1]),
    MeanNPX   = mean(vals, na.rm = TRUE),
    estimate  = if (length(v1) && length(v2)) mean(v2) - mean(v1) else NA_real_,
    conf.low  = if (is.null(tt)) NA_real_ else tt$conf.int[1],
    conf.high = if (is.null(tt)) NA_real_ else tt$conf.int[2],
    p.value   = if (is.null(tt)) NA_real_ else tt$p.value,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  names(row)[1] <- assay_col
  if ("Panel" %in% names(sub)) row$Panel <- as.character(sub$Panel[1])
  row
})
de_res <- data.table::rbindlist(de_rows, use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
de_res[, Adjusted_pval := stats::p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH")]
de_res <- de_res[order(p.value)]
top_hits <- head(de_res[[assay_col]], 6)

}

screen_assays <- unique(c(de_res[p.value < 0.05][[assay_col]], head(de_res[[assay_col]], 15)))
sub_lmm <- df[df[[assay_col]] %in% screen_assays, , drop = FALSE]

fit_sc <- function(d_in, rhs, label) {
  rows <- lapply(split(d_in, d_in[[assay_col]]), function(d) {
    fml <- stats::as.formula(paste0("`", value_col, "` ~ ", rhs))
    m <- tryCatch(lmerTest::lmer(fml, data = d), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(m)) return(NULL)
    at <- tryCatch(stats::anova(m), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(at)) return(NULL)
    keep_t <- intersect(c(group_col, ".time_f", paste0(group_col, ":.time_f")), rownames(at))
    if (!length(keep_t)) return(NULL)
    data.frame(
      Scenario = label,
      Assay    = d[[assay_col]][1],
      Term     = gsub(".time_f", time_col, keep_t, fixed = TRUE),
      F_value  = round(at[keep_t, "F value"], 3),
      p.value  = signif(at[keep_t, "Pr(>F)"], 3),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
  do.call(rbind, rows)
}

sc_tab <- rbind(
  fit_sc(sub_lmm, sprintf("`%s` + .time_f + (1 | `%s`)", group_col, subject_col), "Scenario 1: Main Effects"),
  fit_sc(sub_lmm, sprintf("`%s` * .time_f + (1 | `%s`)", group_col, subject_col), "Scenario 2: Group x Time")
)
sc_sig <- sc_tab[sc_tab$p.value < 0.05, , drop = FALSE]
sc_sig <- sc_sig[order(sc_sig$p.value), , drop = FALSE]
if (nrow(sc_sig) > 0 && requireNamespace("DT", quietly = TRUE)) {
  DT::datatable(sc_sig, rownames = FALSE, filter = "top",

}

5 Pathway Enrichment & Protein Interaction Network

net_genes <- if (exists("de_res")) {
  unique(c(de_res[p.value < 0.05][[assay_col]], head(de_res[[assay_col]], 12)))
} else {
  head(unique(df[[assay_col]]), 15)
}
enr <- tryCatch(enrich_pathways(net_genes), error = function(e) NULL)
if (!is.null(enr) && nrow(enr) > 0) {
  enr_dt <- as.data.table(enr)
  enr_summary <- enr_dt[, .(
    n_proteins = uniqueN(Protein),
    Proteins   = paste(sort(unique(Protein)), collapse = ", "),
    p_value    = min(p_value, na.rm = TRUE)
  ), by = .(source, term_id, Pathway)][order(p_value)]

  if (requireNamespace("DT", quietly = TRUE)) {
    enr_show <- copy(enr_summary)
    enr_show[, p_value := signif(p_value, 3)]
    dt_enr <- DT::datatable(
      enr_show, rownames = FALSE, filter = "top", width = "100%",
      class = "table table-sm table-hover",
      options = list(pageLength = 8, scrollX = TRUE, dom = "ftip")
    )
    print(DT::formatStyle(
      dt_enr, "p_value",
      fontWeight = DT::styleInterval(0.05, c("600", "normal")),
      color      = DT::styleInterval(0.05, c("#0F766E", "#64748B"))
    ))
  }

  if (exists("de_res") && any(is.finite(de_res$estimate))) {
    top_pw <- head(enr_summary$Pathway, 10)
    enr_top <- enr[enr$Pathway %in% top_pw, , drop = FALSE]
    enr_fc <- merge(enr_top, as.data.frame(de_res[, .(Protein = get(assay_col), estimate)]),
                    by = "Protein", all.x = TRUE)
    tryCatch(
      plot_pathway_network(enr_fc, value_col = "estimate", top_n = 10,
                           title = "Top 10 Enriched Pathways & Associated Proteins"),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
  }
}
